findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed ATM draw on this name; the May 2026 underwritten offering at $3.50 (3.73m shares) is the only financing in the baseline's window, and the 2026-05-22 drop (-8.19%) was followed by +3.51% the next session.
findings.why_not_priced: Capacity is ~1.94m shares at $2.57, about 17 sessions of today's ~110k-share volume and 4.7% of shares outstanding; a grinding two-day 19% fall on ordinary volume with no news is the shape an agent selling into the tape would leave, but nothing confirms it is drawing, so the price holds at most a fraction of it. If it were active and known, the stock would not bounce on the low-volume base rate.
